changeSet.author: Artem Prokudin
changeSet.sql: insert into role_permission (role_id, permission_id) select r.id, p.id from role r join permission p on p.name = 'COPY_EXERCISE_TO_GLOBAL_POOL' where r.name in ('EDUCATION_RESOURCE_ADMIN', 'TEACHER');

rollback.sql: delete rp from role_permission rp join role r on r.id = rp.role_id join permission p on p.id = rp.permission_id where r.name in ('EDUCATION_RESOURCE_ADMIN', 'TEACHER') and p.name = 'COPY_EXERCISE_TO_GLOBAL_POOL';

changeSet.author: Artem Prokudin
changeSet.sql: delete rua from role_user_assignment rua join role r on r.id = rua.role_id join user u on u.id = rua.user_id where r.name = 'GLOBAL_EXERCISE_AUTHOR' and u.external_id not like '%/realms/%';
